data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'loros' meaning 'glory' or 'fame'. In ancient Greek mythology, Loran was a name given to warriors and champions. In Christianity, Lorrin is associated with the virtues of strength, courage, and valor. The name Lorrin carries the meaning “Famed warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lorrin usually hope their child will grow to embody famed warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
